en-US: Support rich-text headings through H6 in the toolbar, slash commands, and Markdown, including Android, iOS, export, and WeChat copy.
Window the memo list so only visible cards mount, keeping long notebooks responsive while scrolling.
Reuse the editor across notes, prefetch details on pointer down, and skip the card-menu scroll lock so switching short notes no longer remounts the editor.
Recycle the hidden desktop renderer after a long background session or a high working set, then restore the last notebook and note when the window reopens.
Drop decoded images and previous note bodies when switching notes so image-heavy notes do not keep bitmaps and JSON in the renderer.
zh-CN: 富文本标题支持到六级：工具栏、斜杠命令和 Markdown 都可用，并同步到安卓、iOS、导出和公众号复制。
笔记列表只渲染当前可见的卡片，笔记本很长时滚动不再把全部卡片挂进页面。
切换笔记时复用编辑器、按下时预取正文，并去掉卡片菜单的滚动锁定，短笔记不再整页重挂编辑器。
桌面端在长时间后台或占用偏高时回收隐藏的渲染进程，重新打开窗口时恢复上次的笔记本和笔记。
切换笔记时释放上一篇的图片和解码后的正文，避免图多的笔记把位图和 JSON 留在渲染进程里。
